entities.name: Institute of Technology of Cambodia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Institute of Technology of Cambodia, known for short as Sala Techno, is a higher education institution in Phnom Penh, Cambodia that trains students in science, technology and engineering. Enrollment is approximately 3,500 undergraduate students and 200 graduate students.
